actor_access: ordinary feedback and note only; no solver state or recommended query
curator_access: prior note and batch of3 public histories/count curves/first-singleton; no labels or heldout IDs/results
curator_prompt: You improve a reusable question-selection note for future independent number-guessing games. Each secret has four distinct decimal digits; a leading zero is allowed. Feedback counts correct digits in correct positions and correct digits in different positions. A question may repeat digits. The actor sees only the original game instructions, its strategy note, and the current game guesses and feedback. It never sees candidate lists, candidate counts, recommended guesses, or the monitor. An exact public-feedback monitor starts with every legal secret, stops when only one possibility remains, and otherwise stops after twenty-five questions. Your goal is fewer questions to unique identification without reducing the probability of identification. The summaries report counts before and after each public question, whether identification occurred, and capped query cost; unresolved episodes have capped cost twenty-five. These are training episodes only. Derive general query-selection advice from them, retaining useful previous advice and correcting unproductive patterns. If no episodes are supplied, write one rule-based strategy without claiming experience. General numerical strategies and opening sequences are allowed. Do not claim that memorized answers to individual training episodes identify future secrets. Return the complete replacement note, not a critique or explanation: one to twelve lines, each starting with '- ', English printable ASCII, at most eight hundred UTF-8 bytes, digits are allowed, no URLs, no backticks or pipes. Do not number the bullets; numerical examples inside bullet rules are allowed. If the previous note should be retained, return exactly KEEP. Only the note or KEEP is permitted.
limits: Outcome-informed follow-up after prior trials; new heldout data does not erase sequential design choices.
Text adaptation with tool-supervised training signal, not model weight learning.
No-note comparison tests complete adaptation package; static control does not match18extra rewrite calls.
Public uniqueness is information sufficiency, not internal beliefs.
Single task/model, restricted internal data; prior model pretraining exposure unknown.
Stopped trajectories have no final model query; external answer extraction receives all credit.
Observed throughput admission is not a runtime guarantee.

parser_contract.documentation_status: Public clarification of the unchanged run rule; not a post-run protocol amendment.
parser_contract.overlong_numeral_behavior: For an isolated five- or six-digit numeral, the single match is its first four digits.
parser_contract.repeated_digit_guesses: Legal queries; candidate secrets still have four distinct digits.
parser_contract.selection: Last non-overlapping match, normalized to decimal digit characters; no match is malformed and consumes a query.
